description: Shape 0 (n=32, b=20) sits at 1.01x on cuSOLVER syevj; a sibling proved 20 matrices underfill the GPU (20/148 SMs) and per-matrix/persistent Jacobi lost to the vendor kernel. BOLD different parallelization: pack the tiny 32x32 problem so ALL 148 SMs work -- e.g. warps-per-matrix with MANY matrices resident (a fully-unrolled register-resident analytic/Jacobi 32x32 eigensolver, each warp solving one matrix, hundreds of warps concurrent) OR a closed-form/low-degree-polynomial path exploiting n=32's tiny size. The lever is filling the machine at batch=20, not out-implementing syevj per-matrix. Targets occupancy/insufficient-parallelism; residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback, route guarded.

t1: warp-per-matrix register-resident 2-sided cyclic Jacobi (n<=32), lane l owns row l of A+V, round-robin ordering, __shfl broadcast (no SMEM/no barriers). 39/39 VALID; eigenvalue accuracy excellent (eigr_rel 1.9e-5 << 5.3e-4 gate). Shape 0 1760us vs cuSOLVER 161us (11x SLOWER); geomean 32833 vs ref 27322. ~160 shuffles/round x31 rounds x12 sweeps=~59k shuffles/matrix dominates; only 20 warps=machine underfilled. Orth marginal (orth_max 2-7e-4 vs 2.67e-4 gate).

t2: merge CURRENT BEST cf3d49aa8 (brief-110 single-pass-CQR) into brief-113; warp-Jacobi shape-0 work carried cleanly (orthogonal to shape-3/9/11 CQR). MEASURED merged geomean 32604; shape 0 still 1766us (warp-Jacobi) vs cuSOLVER 161us; other shapes reflect cf3d49aa8 (s3 73410, s9 35651, s12 29089). nbad=1/20 every iter. New reference for shape-0 work.

t3: refactor warp-Jacobi — wjac_partner() device helper recomputes round-robin partner locally (removes partner/lowj shuffles); shadow-array all-columns update (snapshot avoids RAW). 39/39 VALID, eigr_rel 2.3e-5 converged, nbad 2/20. Shape 0 3131us (19x cuSOLVER 161us); geomean 34018. High register pressure (oldA[32]+oldV[32]+prow[32]) spilling. Low-column-only column update broke eigr->0.8, reverted. Perf lever: cut sweeps + registers.

t4: sweeps 12->6. At 6 sweeps warp-Jacobi is cleaner: eigr_rel 1.2e-5, orth 8e-5, nbad=0/20 (12 sweeps over-rotated -> round-off -> 2 fallbacks). 39/39 VALID. Shape 0 1698us (10.5x cuSOLVER 161us); geomean 32463. sweeps-to-converge <=6.

t5: TRULY register-resident redesign (n=32 wjac_solve32<SW> template, sweep+31-round loops unrolled at compile-time so pj folds constant; diag/off-diag via masked reduction over constant-indexed Ar[k], not Ar[partner]). Fixes the t4 local-memory bottleneck (was 98.8% L1TEX local traffic, ncu Est.Local.Speedup 99.72%). Ar/Vr now in registers. Shape 0 1698->909us (1.87x); eigr 1.2e-5 nbad=0/20 39/39 VALID; geomean 31013. Still 5.6x cuSOLVER 161us.

t6: IN-KERNEL sort via lane-rank + global scatter (removes torch.sort+gather+bitonic+scatter, ~4 launches + b*n*n gather). nsys(t5): kernel 340us=77% but ~570us host launch overhead dominates wall (30 tiny launches vs cuSOLVER's 1). 39/39 VALID eigr 1.3e-5 nbad=0/20. Shape 0 909->745us (1.22x); geomean 30501. Still 4.6x cuSOLVER 161us.

t7: kernel micro-opt sweep (both noise/regression, documented): (1) interleaved row update (saves 32 regs, drifts orth, nbad 0->1, perf noise); (2) shuffle-s-only+reconstruct cj (halves col shuffles 64->32, perf NOISE 728vs725, nbad 0->1). DECISIVE: kernel is dependency-chain LATENCY-bound at 20 warps, NOT shuffle-throughput/occupancy bound. Kept both-shuffle+prow nbad=0. Shape 0 725us; geomean 30406; 39/39 VALID.
